title: Student Financial Aid for academic reporters
note:
Undergraduate students (Academic Reporters)
1 - The total number of students enrolled in Fall 2024 [Section 1: Part A - Establish Your Student Counts, Line 02/03/04]
If STYPE=1, then All undergraduate students, if STYPE=2, then All degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students, if STYPE=3, then All non-degree/non-certificate-seeking undergraduate students.
2 - Grant or scholarship aid from the federal government, state/local government, the institution, and other sources known to the institution (Do NOT include student loans) [Section 1: Part B/C/D, Line 01]
3 - Grants or scholarships from the federal government, state/local government, or the institution (Do NOT include student loans) [Section 1: Part B/C/D, Line 01a]
4 - Grant or scholarship aid from other sources known to the institution (Do NOT include student loans) [Section 1: Part B/C/D, Line 01b]
5 - Federal grants and scholarship aid [Section 1: Part B/C/D, Line 02]
6 - Federal Pell Grants [Section 1: Part B/C/D, Line 02a]
7 - Other federal grants and scholarship aid [Section 1: Part B/C/D, Line 02b]
8 - State/local government grant or scholarship aid (includes fellowships, waivers, and employee exemptions) [Section 1: Part B/C/D, Line 03]
9 - Institutional grant or scholarship aid (includes fellowships, waivers, and employee exemptions) [Section 1: Part B/C/D, Line 04]
10 - Loans to students [Section 1: Part B/C/D, Line 05]
11 - Federal loans to students [Section 1: Part B/C/D, Line 05a]
12 - Other loans to students (including private loans) [Section 1: Part B/C/D, Line 05b]

Full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students
1 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students enrolled in Fall 2024 [Section 1: Part A - Establish Your Student Counts, Line 05]
2 - Not Applicable (For program reporters)
3 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who were awarded any Federal Work Study, loans to students, or grant or scholarship aid from the federal government, state/local government, the institution, or other sources known to the institution [Section 1: Part A - Establish Your Student Counts, Line 06]
4 - Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who were awarded any loans to students or grant or scholarship aid from the federal government, state/local government, or the institution [Section 1: Part A - Establish Your Student Counts, Line 07]

Full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students awarded aid
1 - FTFT students who were awarded grant or scholarship aid from the federal government, state/local government, the institution, and other sources known to the institution (Do NOT include student loans) [Section 1: Part E, Line 01]
2 - FTFT students who were awarded grants or scholarships from the federal government, state/local government, or the institution (Do NOT include student loans) [Section 1: Part E, Line 01a]
3 - FTFT students who were awarded grant or scholarship aid from other sources known to the institution (Do NOT include student loans) [Section 1: Part E, Line 01b]
4 - FTFT students who were awarded federal grants and scholarship aid [Section 1: Part E, Line 02]
5 - FTFT students who were awarded federal Pell Grants [Section 1: Part E, Line 02a]
6 - FTFT students who were awarded other federal grants and scholarship aid [Section 1: Part E, Line 02b]
7 - FTFT students who were awarded state/local government grant or scholarship aid (includes fellowships, waivers, and employee exemptions) [Section 1: Part E, Line 03]
8 - FTFT students who were awarded institutional grant or scholarship aid (includes fellowships, waivers, and employee exemptions) [Section 1: Part E, Line 04]
9 - FTFT students who were awarded and accepted loans to students [Section 1: Part E, Line 05]
10 - FTFT students who were awarded and accepted federal loans to students [Section 1: Part E, Line 05a]
11 - FTFT students who were awarded and accepted other loans to students (including private loans) [Section 1: Part E, Line 05b]
